model: helical site-by-site scan on the w-column cylinder; NN edges (0,1)+(1,0); NNN adds the inter-row diagonals (1,1) and (1,-1) (the (1,-1) edge routed through one-step shadow endpoints)
class_definition: partition of the w columns read off the scan slots; EMPTY slots are singletons indistinguishable from occupied singletons; classes recorded at every scan phase

bond_anchor.note: bond closure at w=8 computed by the standalone exact run; 2^16 row configs per state, ~10 min each variant

conclusion: site helical frontier: NN classes 1,2,5,13,34,88,232,620 (all noncrossing, strict subset of Catalan; missing the nested-pocket classes); NNN classes 1,2,5,12,27,61,142,340 = the row-cut class sequence (all noncrossing, zero crossing classes through w=8, NNN strictly inside NN, and NNN-all-phase == NN-row-cut elementwise per width).  Bond anchor with sealed semantics: planar == cylinder == Catalan(w) elementwise for w=1..8 (1,2,5,14,42,132,429,1430).  So the #636 Catalan(w) cost-model premise is CORRECT for the bond boundary-state space, WRONG for the site frontier, and the matching-lattice (NNN) boundary classes stay noncrossing through w=8.
